details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_git_subprocess_env (lines 2979-2992), _inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication was replaced with embedding `GH_TOKEN` in HTTPS origin URLs.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in subprocess arguments, `/proc`, Git diagnostics, persisted remotes, and `MemoryGitError` output; credential-stripped checkouts also lose the prior authentication mechanism.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:memory_ensure_branch (lines 137-184), _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 564-585), force-tick clone/push calls (lines 767, 883, 919) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was removed, leaving bare unauthenticated Git operations, while force-tick URLs embed the PAT.
  WHY: `persist-credentials: false` checkouts cannot initialize or update `ai-memory`, and force-tick credentials leak through process arguments and Git diagnostics.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:normalize_path (lines 240-247), emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was removed, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths to read credential-bearing files.
  WHY: `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, `.netrc`, and related files can be inlined into model prompts and sent to the provider; existing imports and tests also fail.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context (lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The path-count cap and byte accounting for headers and markers were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can generate output beyond `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`, exhausting model context or causing downstream token-limit failures.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:lines 50-52 (dropped `source scripts/codex_helpers.sh`), codex invocation at line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose execution changed from brokered sanitized read-only execution to bare `codex exec --sandbox danger-full-access`.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content can access or exfiltrate `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, mutate the workspace, or modify `.git`.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest (lines 766-772), GraphQL comments (lines 833-848, 913-924) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval verification cannot authenticate producer comments or authorize approvers even if the deleted helpers are restored.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:lines 52-141 (entire broker lifecycle removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `model_provider_broker_*` lifecycle and sanitized-execution APIs were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Codex-backed phases fail with `model_provider_broker_start: command not found` and the credential-isolation boundary is eliminated.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:lines 493-498 (git_with_github_auth), lines ~947-1352 (review_blocked_* functions removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the `review_blocked_*` helper family were deleted while judge and orchestrator callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal actions, successor-issue handling, approval verification, judge-fix pushes, and baseline pushes fail or become unavailable.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:usage/parser/validation hunks (lines 29-148), base_url at line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` and its validation were removed and the provider URL was hard-coded.
  WHY: Existing callers exit with `unknown argument: --provider-base-url`, while broker loopback routing is bypassed or cannot be configured.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:usage line 7, option parsing lines 30-66, deleted process-group supervision body | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and isolated process-group supervision were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with `unknown option`, and privileged descendants are no longer identity-checked, killed, or verified.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:staged-support restore block (lines 98-237) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, which `.github/workflows/implement.yml` never exports.
  WHY: The guard is unreachable, so self-repository implementation runs can still overwrite branch-owned helper edits with `SCRIPT_REF` copies.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:lines 68-81 ("Configure git auth for memory helper clones") and subsequent memory steps | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_*` authentication exports are scoped to one step and are not inherited by later memory-helper steps.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, later `memory_ensure_branch` Git operations run against a credential-free origin, fail open, and leave `ai-memory` uninitialized.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:pre_assembled_static.txt cleanup (lines 59-65) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup now checks the index instead of `HEAD`, restores only the worktree, and no longer removes index-only entries.
  WHY: A staged artifact absent from `HEAD` can remain staged or cause `git restore --source=HEAD` to fail, allowing `pre_assembled_static.txt` into the commit.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:lines 1-76 (new SSB branch) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The handler depends on missing or improperly populated `SSB_FILES`/`SSB_REASON`, and best-effort GitHub commands swallow latch failures.
  WHY: The human latch may not be applied, conflict details may be empty or sentinel values, and deterministic conflicts can repeatedly redispatch.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:python3-unavailable path (lines 127-132) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The Python-unavailable isolated-launch fail-closed path was removed.
  WHY: Isolated commands can run without watchdog, heartbeat, signal forwarding, or cleanup, leaving hung or orphaned processes.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:git merge-file invocation (lines 202-205) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The three-way merge arguments are in the wrong order.
  WHY: The merge uses the wrong base and can drop branch-owned changes or produce incorrect conflict markers.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 668 (`codex ... --sandbox danger-full-access`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config` reads `${HOME:-/root}/.codex/config.toml` rather than the configured `${CODEX_HOME}` path.
  WHY: When `CODEX_HOME` is set, reasoning settings can be written to the wrong configuration and the diagnose invocation can use stale settings.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1726-1729; baseline push fallback at 2428-2431 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Terminal review-blocked actions exit successfully when approval helpers are missing, and baseline pushes fall back to unauthenticated Git.
  WHY: Merge, follow-up, and close/reissue actions never complete, while reissue baseline branches are not published.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=[5]

  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh
  confidence=[5]

  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/write_codex_config.sh, scripts/targeted_file_context.py, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh
